data.body: **[P2] Keep the new timeout additive to the existing call signature.** Existing keyword callers that omit this argument now raise `TypeError`, while positional callers that previously passed `output_dir` bind that path as the timeout and can lose history output or fail during log polling. `CloudWatchLogRetriever` similarly breaks its prior two-client constructor. Keep `output_dir` in its original position, append this parameter with a `120.0` default, and give the retriever timeout the same default, preferably through a shared constant.
